d: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijit Dipke has accused the Modi government of suppressing political content on social media platforms, alleging that posts without the Prime Minister's photograph face reduced visibility. At a press conference in Nagpur, Dipke also alleged vote theft and accused the government of trying to dilute the Constitution and Babasaheb Ambedkar's ideas. CJP leaders also announced plans to expand their 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign to several states.
